reviews.text:
"Visually, this game is a masterpiece.... of sucking ♥♥♥♥!"

But fr the only good things here are sitting on the gondola with a friend, or sitting on the ground with a friend, or the 5 minute puzzle to get an egg where you just sit down.

This is probably the most overrated game this year. Is it bad? 100% no, Is it great? Far from it. Puzzle quality ranges from really, really fun to absolute ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥. The falling mechanics are fun, but movement in general is clunky. Death Stranding 1 comes to mind. Just really a meh experience at points with fun bits. 6/10, recommended particularly for puzzle fans.

In the face of this year's Saros, Mixtape, Mina The Hollower, Slay the Spire 2, and Doom The Dark Age's DLC, [GAME TITLE] perhaps illustrates best what gamers are missing out on: understanding what makes games TRULY high quality with gameplay at the core.

reviews.name: 007 First Light
reviews.text:
Very good! Pros and cons:

Pros:
-Great graphics
-The story is engaging with a solid cast of characters and plot twists
-The high-tier voice acting does a great job immersing the player into the story
-Gun fights, which are similar to the Uncharted series, are fun and engaging
-This is a peek example of role play, where you feel like [REDACTED] the entire time
-The gadgets are fun to use and add a lot of variety
-The fact there are several leads you can follow in each micro-section of the game is great
-Levels might be linear, but most have immense detail and plenty to look at and do
-The prologue is one of the better video games openings among all recent releases - they did a really great job introducing the player to the game's mechanics and overall vibe

Cons:
-The second half of the story does drag a bit in certain areas
-The bluff and lure system is far less developed and fun to use than the rest of the game's core mechanics
-Sometimes it can be easy to get stuck on terrain
-I experienced 2 crashes while playing the game
-For some reason they steered very heavily away from any detail of [REDACTED]'s romantic encounters, heavily contrary to the movies
-Character models excluding the main cast are pretty mediocre

[GAME TITLE] had a ton to live up to and exceeded my expectations, but it is not perfect like a lot of people are saying.

A massively strong 8/10!

reviews.name: Directive 8020
reviews.text:
[GAME TITLE] is not a BAD game, but it ended up well below my expectations.

Pros:
-The majority of the voice acting is high-level
-Soundtrack is very solid
-Several vistas are scenic and beautiful
-The main plot twist is actually quite solid

Cons
-Facial animations look straight out of 2010. So, so bad
-Most of the game takes place inside of the ship, and much of it looks the same - this is in direct contrast to something like Dead Space, where the environments are quite varied
-The core gameplay loop is "sneak around this alien creature" - clinically unfun
-QTEs were few and far between, and at this point in gaming development history they should be a thing of the past
-Some plot elements drag heavily
-Once again several death opportunities come out of nowhere and feel unearned
-Few characters actually stand out as interesting, with the most interesting probably being [REDACTED]

Overall, it's a 5/10 - very mediocre. I'd say worth a playthrough when on a deep sale.

reviews.name: Mixtape
reviews.text:
[GAME TITLE] is practically a masterpiece, and goes to show brief games can still hit harder than 30-100 hour AAA titles.

Pros:
-Not shockingly, the music choices are flawless
-Characters are well written and you feel like you are hanging out with 'em the entire time
-No humor is forced
-Art style is amazing
-"If you don't feel something while playing, wipe yourself off man. Because YOU are DEAD." -Dunkey
-Color usage in this is fantastic
-Movement is simple but enjoyable
-After the game's final cutscene I genuinely wanted to know what was going to happen to all three characters in the future, which is pretty damn rare in gaming these days
-Voice acting is near-flawless

Cons
-1 or 2 plot points could be considered cliche

Overall - [GAME TITLE] is the 25th game out of about 400 or so titles I will give a 10 out of 10.

EDIT - after scrolling through some reviews it is fair to say this game is actively being review-bombed. Pathetic. Play this game.

reviews.name: PRAGMATA
reviews.text:
Very good, but its flaws cut heavily at the overall experience.

Pros
-Good art style and a solid space-station style setting.
-Combat's core mechanics remain engaging (for the most part) until the end of the 10 hour story.
-[REDACTED]-game charm style remains strong here.
-Level design is mostly cool, especially the NYC area.
-The shelter is a decent hub area and they clearly put effort into making it varied.
-Gun types are pretty varied and have a lot of uses.
-Sound design, especially for the weapons, is quite good.
-Music is largely good.

Cons
-The constant comments like "take this" or "watch out" etc from [REDACTED] and (especially) [REDACTED] during combat and exploration. Classic mistake made by a lot of games.
-Several level design components are just "unlock 5 locks to unlock the door" and that just isn't great
-Story is a bit plain outside of a decent ending.
-Plot twists are very predictable.

7/10

reviews.name: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire
reviews.text:
Very good.

Pros
-Amazing animations for both the guns and characters
-Cool environments
-Fun overworld
-Combat is overall enjoyable, very 2016 Doom-like
-Lots of love was clearly poured into the world
-Voice acting is top-tier
-The ideas here are fun
-Some of the story is quite interesting
-Troy Baker just kills it in every way
-Sound design and music are both excellent

Cons
-Gets repetitive in both combat and mission type
-Game feels longer than it actually is due to repetition
-Some guns are not as powerful as others and are given at uneven points throughout the game
-Exploration is not rewarding
-Several story points are very forgettable

Strong 8/10

reviews.name: REPLACED
reviews.text:
Good. Small spoilers below.

Pros
-Art design and graphical style are incredible. One of the most unique-looking games I have ever played, and worth savoring.
-Sound design is great! Melee combat feels crunchy and is helped by haptic feedback.
-Several story parts are extremely engaging, especially with how topical AI is.
-Main character has an intriguing back story.
-Several side characters were interesting, especially [REDACTED].
-Animations are great
-Music is great

Cons
-Black bars. Just zero reason to have them.
-Combat can get repetitive and not always 100% responsive. It should have been expanded on a lot more.
-Platforming is low quality and controls for it are not as tight as they should be. In a world of Silksongs and Mario 64s, there was just too much emphasis on platforming here that dragged [GAME TITLE] down.
-Some story beats were dragged.
-Some quest design felt meant to extend the game's length instead of give actual meaning.
-Quest rewards were mostly uninteresting.
-They introduce a massive city at the end of the game and only use it for a little bit...so disappointing

7/10, the quality of the pros and the game as a whole slightly outweigh the lengthy con list.

A 5/10 is generous, but that's what I will give it since they did actually try to be unique.

reviews.name: DOOM: The Dark Ages
reviews.hours: 23.2 hrs on record (15.3 hrs at review time)
reviews.text:
[GAME TITLE] is a fantastic follow-up to [REDACTED]'s [GAME TITLE] 2016 and [REDACTED]. Let's hit the pros and cons list (minor spoilers ahead).

Pros:
-Fantastic graphical performance and stability. On ultra-nightmare settings, I had zero frame drops and only a single crash that occurred during the final boss.
-The combat flows tremendously well, which was expected. The shield does not slow things down, but instead adds to the gameplay's depth.
-Capes. Kratos, [REDACTED]... who's next?
-The cutscenes are more ambitious than [REDACTED]'s previous titles.
-You can turn game speed up, which I did to 130% on Nightmare difficulty.
-The sound design is the best in [GAME TITLE]'s history, with the [REDACTED] slamming into the ground with intense force, weapons that boom and sizzle, and ripping and tearing until the game is done.
-Graphically, the environments are stunning.
-Beating the more difficult combat encounters feels rewarding.
-While both the dragon and mech sections fall short in depth, they are fun adventures that add to the game's epic scale. Reviewers are being far too critical here.
-Nearly all skins for the [REDACTED] and his weapons are well made.
-Sprinting feels great and makes up for the lack of [REDACTED]'s dash ability just fine.

Cons:
-Melee weapons feel great to use but did not always strike as quickly as I would like them to.
-There is no buff to switch weapon swap speed.
-The final boss is much more disappointing than the second-to-last fight, and is also a gank. Not a great choice.
-The need to switch repeatedly between weapons is reduced heavily from [REDACTED], which while an individual player choice in my view weakens the overall experience.

Overall, the game gets a FAT SmartButAutistic 9/10. I wanted to give it a 9.5 so badly, and it almost gets there, but falls just short. Great work, [REDACTED]!

reviews.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
reviews.text:
Welp, finished [GAME TITLE] and boy was it damn interesting. Time to hit the ol' pros and cons list. Mild spoilers ahead.

Pros:
-An incredible art style that really isn't comparable to much else out there
-For a studio's first game, this is just an insane accomplishment
-Near-flawless voice acting (s/o to [REDACTED], man oh man)
-A complex, extremely dynamic story with a unique premise and plenty of ripe emotion (EDIT: it is even deeper than I thought...)
-Turn-based combat that is somehow NOT ♥♥♥♥ and heavily emphasizes strategy and thinking
-Somehow won't make you pissed off at [REDACTED]
-Attack animations are cool enough to never get sick of
-Outfits & hairstyles are varied and fun (for a very somber and stressful game, [REDACTED] is sometimes okay with taking itself a little less seriously)
-Heavily varied landscapes
-Forces the player to accept that decision making in their personal lives is never, ever easy - conveying important messages without cliché is near-impossible in modern gaming, but [REDACTED] succeeds here
-Can tap [REDACTED]

Cons:
-Although the story is gripping and complex, there are two or three unexplained plot points (especially surrounding [REDACTED]) that left a bit to be desired
-A handful of boss attacks lacked a clear enough telegraph to properly parry & a few attacks do too much damage while others do too little
-Several boss encounters take 15 to 25 minutes, meaning if you lose restarting will be extremely frustrating
-Some extremely important tutorials do not pop up unless you interactive with a specific part of the menu
-Exploration is mostly linear
-Some enemies have obnoxious levels of shielding

[REDACTED] is having one hell of a year to be in both [REDACTED] AND this... Great job, [DEVELOPER] - can't wait to see what's next! EDIT: Up from 9/10 to 9.5/10 after further analysis.

reviews.name: Invincible Presents: Atom Eve
reviews.text:
Extremely solid for a turn-based RPG. The story is gripping despite the lack of voice acting, and [REDACTED] maintains her status as one of the most unique female superheroes of all time. The combat is basic but mostly fun, a handful of the fights require some tactical thinking, and the comic style (unsurprisingly) works very well graphically. For its price, a 6 hour game is perfectly fine. I would have liked to have learned even more about [REDACTED] through the game, but obviously the show special does that well enough.

8/10

reviews.name: The First Berserker: Khazan
reviews.text:
Quick breakdown of pros and cons:

Pros:
-Combat is incredible. S-tier in terms of both all games and souls-likes.
-Armor sets are varied, have different uses, and the majority are quite cool-looking.
-The sound design and music are both top notch. S/o to [REDACTED] Phase I...masterpiece!
-The art style is unique and adds to the game's already intriguing lore.
-The challenge present in this game is (rarely) B.S.

Cons
-Some bosses have HP that is, frankly, too high - not a skill issue, I have plenty of experience with these games, just a fact. The most prominent example is definitely the final boss's Phase I HP.
-Earning tons of new weapon and armor pieces level by level makes the inventory system feel tedious to manage.
-The GEAR upgrade system is antiquated and not satisfying.

Despite these minor issues, the game stands at a strong 9/10 - an incredible feat by a gaming studio that was not well known and still wanting to make a souls-like.

reviews.text:
Outside of three or so bugs that disrupted some gameplay moments, the game itself is incredibly solid. There is just enough uniqueness to [GAME TITLE] that it doesn't scream "I'm a clone" of X or Y, etc.

The pros:

-The art is just incredible. I mean really - wow. So gorgeous and pretty dang varied.
-The combat feels great - although it does not quite match Kratos' axe or The Penitent One's sword from Blasphemous, [REDACTED]'s sword feels great to swing and the hits feel responsive.
-Outside of a few seconds after loading in, I had 0 performance issues.
-Bosses/enemies are creatively designed.
-There is a good amount of enemy variety for a game that takes 10 or so hours to beat.
-The concept for the story is unquestionably creative.
-Something about the game is addicting and makes you want to keep playing.

The cons:

-The map needs markers. Badly. It can be very difficult to tell what has been left unexplored.
-Some bosses do a little too much damage. Other than that, for experienced gamers this game does not trend on the difficult side.
-There were a handful of bugs that prevented me from accessing certain areas.
-Navigation issues left me backtracking more than I'd like.
-The special moves felt too slow to use in combat with practicality.
-The parry, although satisfying, felt too risky to use in challenging combat scenarios over the dash.
-Aspects of the story are incredibly cryptic, and certain lines of dialogue appear out of place, particularly in [GAME TITLE]' unquestionably dark world.

For its current price, [GAME TITLE] is worth it and a must-buy, especially if you are waiting for big releases in the second half of October. I can easily see myself doing another playthrough of the game in the future.

8.2/10

Genuinely pains me to not recommend this game, which I had looked forward to a long time & pre-ordered, but outside of the incredible art style it has very little going for it.

-Controls are absurdly janky
-Character often faces the other way despite not pressing the reverse option
-Balancing on both normal and hard difficulties is awful (coming from a seasoned gamer)
            -Hard difficulty completely invalidates what it feels like to use a Katana
-Platforming is awkward
-Dialogue is solid, but often overlapped, and crying is extremely loud
-Checkpoints are either extremely close together or way too far apart
-Combat itself can be extremely tedious due to questionable block windows and sword strike timings
-Story is generic
-Skills fill relatively useless outside of standard combat
-Finishers are impossible to perform as it is insanely tough to tell when an enemy is stunned
-It is absurdly easy for enemies to stunlock your character

Update 5/7/22

After beating the game I would not change any of my complaints. In terms of positives, the graphical design is incredible, some of the combos feel good to pull off, and the music is top notch. If you are a patient gamer, I'd recommend trying it once it's on sale or if you have GamePass. The individuals criticizing this review are clearly [REDACTED] fanboys or just braindead.

reviews.hours: 44.8 hrs on record (21.6 hrs at review time)
reviews.text:
[GAME TITLE] is one of those games that people that desire challenge and an all around solid gaming experience have got to play.

The pros:

-Intensely good lore
-The art is delightfully intense and gorgeous
-The sword the sword makes when you impale an enemy is deeply satisfying and never gets old
-All 4-5 skins the game has are amazing and unlocking them somehow feels really great
-The devs are always around on discord to answer any and all questions
-The enemy types are varied, but combat and design really shines when you combat the bosses (Warning: Boss Baby is scary)
-The soundtrack is really great, I especially love the designs of the [REDACTED] and [REDACTED] fights
-Multiple playthroughs will not feel like a chore
-Did I mention how cool the devs are? I did? Well, here it is again.
-The map helps you reveal secrets
-Items are diverse and unique (see cons for discussion on collectables)

Cons:

-♥♥♥♥♥♥' 1-shot spikes
-*Some* excessive backtracking
-*Some* unresponsive controls (most of the time you mess up, it tends to be your fault, but there are jumps that make me go "wtf" every time I take them)
-It's a tad short for the price, but I bought the deluxe edition and I can safely say I am satisfied with everything I got and the experience I received from playing the game (the [REDACTED] skin is dope, especially if you like the color purple!!!)
-Collectables are kinda lame to get, especially because they really don't do much to aid you on your journey at all. I love lore, but when I work for an item (such as the relic that lets you live through the poison fog which is very satisfying to get) I want to feel good about getting it

All in all, this game is just too beautiful, challenging, and unique to not give a shot.

Solid 8.4/10!

strangers.name: Balatro

strangers.text:
I love this game with all my heart. I love the music, the atmosphere, basically everything about it.

There is only one thing that bothers me. In an earlier demo or earlier version, before the game came out, whenever you were killed, the characters would dance perfectly in sync with the music. They were actually doing proper gabber dancing, and it looked incredibly cool.

Now they mostly just seem to hop around.(sometimes somewhat synced) It looks very different, and it takes away a little bit from the whole feeling for me. They’re no longer really dancing to the music; they’re just jumping around, and that proper gabber-dancing feel seems to be gone.

I don’t know why this was changed or how it happened, but that is genuinely the only thing in the game that isn’t quite up to my personal standards. I really wish the old synchronized dancing would come back, because it looked fantastic.

strangers.name: Somber Echoes

strangers.text: oh what could have been. the bit. it was good, then it wasn't. If only the update ever arrived. One of the best communities i had the pleasure of playing online with. The VOIP was fantastic, the building was fantastic, even the trash talking was all in god fun. I miss you [GAME TITLE]. I miss you.
strangers.name: BattleBit Remastered

strangers.text: Great seriously we need more game like this all i could say the game needs more working on the animations some of them looks perfect and others looks kinda not proper enough.  I would like to see more of it in the future good luck devs
strangers.name: Acts of Blood Demo

strangers.text: Besides the fact this game has no one playing it. My friend and I bought the game. We had a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ blast. The bots do try to murder you if they are the killer. They do collect resources and hoard them sometimes. This game is fun to play with friends. A dead game is only dead until people revive it. Does it need some optimization? Yeah, a bit, there is a delay in when the game announces someone dies. A mic bug that's solved by leaving the lobby and coming back. Those are my biggest issues. However, I love the look of it cause it's like those old PS2 games honestly. I've seen worse graphics. This game is fun and we bought it on a sale. Major props to the Dev who kept putting out content and bug fixes when the game slowed down. Even put out a Halloween event. I hope it comes out this year too, cause I would like to play it with my friends.
strangers.name: Killer in the cabin

strangers.text: For only a dollar it's a fun game to 100%, might as well try it, even though it is rather short.
strangers.name: The Deed

strangers.text: it is hard to say if this game is worth or not. On one hand, its not good. The lack of maps, tools, ability and enemies makes this game extremely repetitive. The really well designed map is just not enough to save the repetitiveness. On the other hand, its just $4.99.
strangers.name: Thick As Thieves

strangers.text:
The game seems really fun so far, but the performance is absolutely abysmal. Turning all settings to low doesn't improve anything either.

I've experienced 3 crashes in the first hour of play.
strangers.name: STAR WARS Zero Company

strangers.text: Great game , highly recommend playing with controller to get the best experience =]
strangers.name: Furi

strangers.text: For the record, I have never played the original so I have no point of comparison. As its own game, I think its pretty neat. Combat is smooth and the difficulty is challenging yet fair. However, I've read other reviews that its only about 30% from the original game so its something to keep in mind. To summarise, its a pretty solid entry and if you liked RE2 remake, you can pick this up on a discount.
strangers.name: Resident Evil 3

strangers.text: Great game, lot's of fun, highly addictive. I think adding a pvp style multiplayer would be fun too, separate bank accounts and business per team or player, fighting to buy out the better businesses and dealers first, being able to fight back and forth over territory and dealers/customers would be fun.
strangers.name: Schedule I

strangers.text: Loved every detail from hiding bodies and using silenced weapons to carefully planning every move. This game demands a lot of patience. Finally completed it, and it was absolutely worth the time!
strangers.name: Hitman: Absolution

strangers.text: Great Action Survival-horror game with an interesting enough story that makes me want to keep going until the end. Took me a while to play it, as I didnt play the original on N64 or the PS4 version. Had to get it during a sale last year and was a worth-wile purchase. Ive played RE2, RE3 and will play RE9 after I finish Alan Wake 2, which is another awesome game btw.
strangers.name: Resident Evil 4

strangers.text: an absolutley fantastic game. runs flawless on steam hardware as well even if it doesnt say verified. i seriously adored this title soooooo so much
strangers.name: Islets

strangers.text: very good and challenging combat with a good story
strangers.name: Solateria Demo

strangers.text: very solid games held back by some audio and visual bugs, while i would reccomend this game i cant due to these visual bugs
strangers.name: Mewgenics

strangers.text: Im late to the party and very new to the game.  I like it so far. I played Green Hell and it seems in the same vain. It gets DARK ! My lighter is so good. So far its a fun game.
strangers.name: The Forest

strangers.text: The gameplay is repetitive, and the game doesn't have anything to offer besides the art direction.
strangers.name: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire

strangers.text: Don't miss the game if you planning to buy it, it worth 100% 👍🏯
strangers.name: Trek to Yomi

strangers.text: Excellent, kinda like a western Hotline Miami.. However there is a gamebreaking bug up until the end where you buy a perk to unlock the ability to dual wield revolvers that makes you unable to reload and have infinite ammo no matter what you do. If you don't mind being unable to dual wield revolvers by not buying the perk or if you preffer other weapons, then i highly reccomend it.. otherwise i advice you to wait until they correct this before buying it.
strangers.name: 12 is Better Than 6

strangers.text:
Absolutely rocks. Interesting loot and areas, amazing potential for worldbuilding, super innovative combat, short and sweet.  PLEASE give this one a try, by yourself or with buddies - it's great either way.

Huge props to the composer(s) too because the music is fantastic.
strangers.name: FlyKnight

strangers.text: Very good pixel art and great enviornments. Retro feel fun for two players. It is hard to distinguish your character sometimes. It would be cool if this game had a sequel with skill trees and a way to customize colors or wardrobe items.
strangers.name: HUNTDOWN

strangers.text:
You don't need me to tell you this, the game has been praised universally, but I wanted to make it clear that this game is a 9.9/10 and literally the only thing that makes this not a 10, is the camera

Not because it's isometric, it's just very finnicky and limited, but if I have to put up with a bit of trying to wrangle a camera to have this masterpiece, I'll wrangle all day
strangers.name: Baldur's Gate 3

strangers.text:
8/10
souls-like with shells as classes
Combat and mechanics are great, switching shells actually changes how you play. Had a lot of fun with it.

 the last third dropped in quality. Glitchy, bosses felt poorly designed, disappointing after how strong the rest was.
Still worth playing.
strangers.name: Mortal Shell II

strangers.text: this is a very fun game you will probably get about an hour out of it but id say theres definetly atleast 5 if you play it again on higher difficulty and play the remix levels if you liked dusk defintely play it. the guns feel good bit simple but not to a fault its on sale often  overall very charming and if you get it on sale definetly worth it 8/10
strangers.name: Chop Goblins

strangers.text:
Much like the first game of the series, this one continues the story of [REDACTED], but with a twist and a universal message.  The art work is fantastic, and the game mechanics are extended a bit to allow for new abilities.  The puzzles are fun (no too hard, but still a good brain exercise), while keeping you on your toes in a few of them.  And of course the story line is captivating, with plenty of cut scenes and moments that touch your heart in a way only the [REDACTED] series games can.

Above all else, it's just really fun and easy to jump in and out of as time permits.  Love.
strangers.name: Planet of Lana II

strangers.text: [GAME TITLE] is fun and frenetic. The action is crisp and smooth. The balance is pretty solid. Of course, there are some stronger blessings than others. I loved the meta progression, and I felt like it was all timed pretty well. The final difficulty is frankly wild. The corruptions in boss rooms on higher difficulties was one thing I did not like. Let the bosses stand on their own merits. [GAME TITLE] is worth the price for sure. Also COOP!
strangers.name: SWORN

strangers.text: This is my new genre which i thought to give a try with my closed friend & it was an great experience, as it's my first split screen experience so i do get a little problem in my first hour but [GAME TITLE] story & gameplay is more movie cinematic type & side story gives you a relax fun time to enjoy even more with your friends. yeah I'm loving the split genre.
strangers.name: A Way Out

strangers.text: [GAME TITLE] is a fun game that really nails the action and feel of being [GAME TITLE]. Unfortunately, it’s held back by a small map that needs more areas to explore and a serious lack of side quests. The story also feels underdeveloped, with several noticeable plot holes. Still, the combat and atmosphere are great. I recommend it for [GAME TITLE] fans, but don’t expect a deep or expansive game.
strangers.name: RoboCop: Rogue City

strangers.text: One of the best roguelite game. And saving game on the EVERY room start make this game my beloved.
strangers.name: Hades

strangers.text:
A lot of cool mechanics and platforming challenges.
The campaign could be a little shorter TBH, notably the first half of it.
But it's a nice game with spatial puzzles where you have to stop and think, and with great dynamic sequences as well.
strangers.name: Bionic Bay

strangers.text:
Randomizing and clearing my backlog 60/343

I played for about 6 more hours offline out of town.
This is one of the best soulslike metroidvanias I have ever played. Absolutely incredible.
strangers.name: Moonscars

strangers.text: This is a very complete and competently made Metroidvania. The bosses are a ton of fun and very creative. There is fun environmental, ability, and enemy variety. The story told is a cute yet also sad story of loss and friendship.
strangers.name: Crypt Custodian

strangers.text: One of the most fun games i've ever played. It is a very hard game, but that makes it even more rewarding when you beat it.
strangers.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong

strangers.text: A beautiful and relaxing pixel-art fishing game where you can slow down, enjoy the peaceful atmosphere, and catch fish at your own pace. 🎣✨
strangers.name: Cast n Chill

strangers.text: this is the type of game that is incredibly fun and entertaining for about 5 rounds, before becoming infuriatingly boring - the Godfather of all friendslop
strangers.name: Among Us

strangers.text:
I'm enjoying the game, but to be fair it doesn't really feel like an [REDACTED] adventure so much as another [REDACTED] game with an [REDACTED] coating. Maybe it will get to that point later in the game where it really feels like [REDACTED] Jones, but so far not while in the Vatican area. 

I like all the collectibles and secrets to find, but I do not like how, so far anyway, the only point of currency is to buy books that reveal map secrets. Like, I want to find the secrets on my own, not use an in-game guide, so give me something else to spend all this money I'm finding on. 

Also the game, which I have set on the hardest difficulty, is painfully easy thus far. I'm hoping that changes.
strangers.name: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle

strangers.text:
if you like [GAME TITLE] you will like this game. Much like the movie, this game is funny obnoxious and honestly fun to play. 

However, you can tell this is an early access game. The game would benefit alot from much more polish, as its really janky at times. The npcs are kinda stupid and the gunplay is a tad mediocre but one thing I will praise is that the movement feels really good. The combat feels intense, and is not too challenging and is very stylish.

the game is silly and i love it. excited for more updates
